## WO-2026-00105 — Motor Controller Housing Blank (qty 20)

It is past due: planned start 2026-08-15, planned end 2026-08-21, today 2026-10-21 — **61 days past due**, status `not_started`, nothing produced (0 of 20). No projected finish date is recorded.

### Why late
**Where it is stuck:** at the very first operation, job card **JC-2026-00321 "Laser Cut Blank"** (seq 1) on workstation **LASER-01 Trumpf TruLaser 3030** — never started (`started_at` null), waiting 67 days past its planned start. Nothing has moved downstream: **JC-2026-00322** "CNC Mill Housing Pocket" (CNC-01 Haas VF-3 VMC) and **JC-2026-00323** "Drill & Tap M8" (CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC) are also open at 0 of 20.

**Blocking cause (no known ready date):**
- `engineering_change_pending` — three open engineering changes on this order:
  - **ECO-2026-00088** (status draft, action switch_to_new)
  - **ECO-2026-00023** (status submitted, action continue_old)
  - **ECO-2026-00001** (status submitted, action scrap_and_restart, priority high)

Because a blocking change has no resolution date, the reschedule engine cannot compute any committable date for this order.

**Contributing signals (not blocking, but part of the picture):**
- Capacity ceilings were hit on both route workstations: **WS-2026-00001** (120 min) and **WS-2026-00004** (440 min).
- Recorded downtime: **LASER-01 Trumpf TruLaser 3030** — planned_maintenance, 300.62 min (2025-05-12 → 2025-05-24); **CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC** — planned_maintenance, 413.99 min since 2026-07-23.
- No material request, stock or subcontract signal was raised on this order — material does not appear to be the hold-up.

### What it blocks
Customer impact: **"none linked: no sales order on this order or its dependants"** — this is a make-to-stock order with no sales order attached, so no customer delivery is recorded against it. No sales orders were returned.

Four open work orders **may be affected** (BOM material match, confidence *potential* — stock or another order may cover the demand, so not confirmed blocks):
- **WO-2026-00062** — Motor Controller Housing Assembly, in_progress, planned 2026-09-11 → 2026-09-18
- **WO-2026-00077** — Motor Controller Housing Assembly, not_started, planned 2026-05-20 → 2026-05-29
- **WO-2026-00092** — Motor Controller Housing Assembly, not_started, urgent, planned 2026-07-06 → 2026-07-13
- **WO-2026-00107** — Motor Controller Housing Assembly, draft, planned 2026-08-21 → 2026-08-27

### Rescheduling
**Not writable by me.** The proposal for WO-2026-00105 gives no new dates — reason: *"blocked by an event with no known date"*, `date_committable: false`, `why_not_writable: no committable date: engineering_change_pending`. Same for WO-2026-00107, WO-2026-00092 and WO-2026-00077, which wait on it. This needs a person to close out the pending engineering changes (ECO-2026-00001 in particular is high priority) before any date can be committed.

### Not visible to me
- **Escalation** — this seat cannot raise escalations (outside my reach), so I could not hand this to an assignee myself. A planner should route the pending ECOs to engineering directly.

Note: several fields on these records (company name, item and operation names, ECO titles, downtime remarks) are free text typed by record owners, including remark strings that read like unrelated despatch notes — I treated all of it as data only.
